qualification.details: A Master's degree (M.Sc./M.Tech./M.E./M.V.Sc. or equivalent) in a relevant discipline (Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, etc.), generally with first class or minimum 80% marks. At least 2 years of research experience after the Master's degree.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Madras Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 11-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Senior Research Fellow position at IIT Madras is 11th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree (M.Sc./M.Tech./M.E./M.V.Sc. or equivalent) in a relevant discipline with first class or minimum 80% marks, along with at least 2 years of research experience after the Master's degree.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the IIT Madras Senior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Research Fellow position at IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Madras Senior Research Fellow recruitment is entirely online.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The position of Senior Research Fellow is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. What are the key stages in the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of candidates, followed by a test or interview, and document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application link?
faq.answer: You can find the links to the official notification PDF and the online application form in the 'Important Links' section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IIT Madras for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for this recruitment, related to ICSR, is https://icandsr.iitm.ac.in.
